# Velcura Medical

> Velcura Medical Technology(Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer of advanced, traditional and surgical wound care dressings in Shenzhen, China. It operates an ISO 13485 quality management system, its products are CE marked and made in an FDA-registered manufacturing facility, and it supplies hospitals, distributors and private-label brands in 100+ countries and regions as an OEM/ODM partner.

Key facts:

- Products: silicone foam, non-adhesive foam, hydrocolloid, calcium alginate and silver alginate, silver hydrophilic fiber, nano-silver, activated charcoal, hydrogel, collagen, biocellulose, super absorbent (SAP), NPWT foam kits, transparent film and IV/PICC securement dressings, surgical incise drapes, skin and wound closure strips, medical tapes, gauze, wound cleanser and silicone scar care.
- Customers: hospital procurement teams, wound care distributors, pharmacies and private-label brands. OEM/ODM with custom sizes, labeling and packaging.
- Manufacturing: 20,000+ m² production base; ISO 13485 quality management system; CE-marked products; FDA-registered facility, with wound dressings and medical tapes listed as Class I devices. FDA registration is not an FDA approval of a product.
- Orders: MOQ depends on product line and packaging; standard production lead time is 25–35 working days from order confirmation.
- Contact: info@velcura.net · +852 9856 7973 (phone and WhatsApp) · Room 2134, 2nd Floor, Building 3, Block 30 (Wenzhengxin Building), 2 Kefa Road, Kejiyuan Community, Yuehai Subdistrict, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong 518057, China. Inquiries are answered within one business day.

## Foam dressings

- [Silicone Foam Dressing](https://velcura.net/silicone-foam-dressing): Five-layer absorbent foam with a soft silicone contact layer and silicone border; atraumatic removal, for moderate to heavy exudate.
- [Foam Dressing Silicone Adhesive Border with Silver](https://velcura.net/silicone-foam-border-AD44): Bordered silicone foam with ionic silver for infected or high-risk exuding wounds.
- [Foam Dressing Silicone Adhesive Border (Sacrum)](https://velcura.net/foam-silicone-border-sacrum): Sacrum-shaped bordered foam for prevention and management of sacral pressure injuries.
- [Foam Dressing Silicone Adhesive Border (Heel)](https://velcura.net/foam-silicone-border-heel): Heel-cupped bordered foam for prevention and management of heel pressure injuries.
- [Foam Dressing Non-Adhesive](https://velcura.net/foam-non-adhesive-AD12): Adhesive-free polyurethane foam for venous leg ulcers, use under compression and fragile skin.
- [Foam Dressing Non-Adhesive (Elbow)](https://velcura.net/foam-non-adhesive-elbow): Anatomically shaped non-adhesive foam for the elbow.
- [Foam Dressing Non-Adhesive (Tracheostomy Tubes)](https://velcura.net/foam-non-adhesive-tracheostomy): Fenestrated keyhole foam that fits around tracheostomy tubes and drains.
- [Silver Foam Dressing Non-Adhesive](https://velcura.net/silver-foam-non-adhesive): Non-adhesive foam with antimicrobial silver for infected and critically colonized wounds.
- [Super Absorbent Dressing](https://velcura.net/super-absorbent-dressing): SAP-core dressing for heavily exuding wounds, bordered or non-adhesive.
- [NPWT Foam Dressing Kit](https://velcura.net/npwt-foam-dressing): Negative pressure wound therapy kit with open-cell foam, drape and tubing.

## Hydrocolloid, alginate and gelling fiber dressings

- [Hydrocolloid Dressing (Super Thin)](https://velcura.net/hydrocolloid-super-thin-AD-HD01): Ultra-thin semi-translucent hydrocolloid for superficial, low-exudate wounds.
- [Hydrocolloid Dressing (with Border)](https://velcura.net/hydrocolloid-dressing-with-border): CMC hydrocolloid framed by a film border that resists rolling and lifting.
- [Hydrocolloid Dressing (Sacrum)](https://velcura.net/hydrocolloid-dressing-sacrum): Sacrum-shaped hydrocolloid that seals against pressure and incontinence moisture.
- [Calcium Alginate Dressing](https://velcura.net/calcium-alginate-AD006): Gelling alginate fibers for moderate to heavy exudate and cavity wounds; supports hemostasis.
- [Silver Alginate Dressing](https://velcura.net/silver-alginate-dressing-AD14): Calcium alginate with controlled-release ionic silver for infected, exuding or bleeding wounds.
- [Silver Hydrophilic Fiber Dressing](https://velcura.net/silver-hydrophilic-fiber-dressing): CMC gelling fiber with ionic silver that absorbs vertically and keeps peri-wound skin dry.

## Antimicrobial and odor control dressings

- [Nano-Silver Medical Antibacterial Dressing](https://velcura.net/nano-silver-antibacterial-AD47): Nanocrystalline silver dressing for chronic, infected and high-risk wounds.
- [Activated Charcoal Dressing Non-Adhesive](https://velcura.net/activated-charcoal-non-adhesive-AD24): Activated charcoal cloth that adsorbs odor, for malodorous and fungating wounds.
- [Silver Activated Charcoal Dressing](https://velcura.net/silver-activated-charcoal): Charcoal with ionic silver for combined odor control and antimicrobial action.

## Moist healing and bioactive dressings

- [Hydrogel Wound Dressing](https://velcura.net/hydrogel-dressing): Sheet, tube and cavity formats that rehydrate dry and necrotic wounds.
- [Collagen Wound Dressing](https://velcura.net/collagen-wound-dressing): Bioactive collagen matrix for chronic non-healing wounds.
- [Biocellulose Dressing](https://velcura.net/biocellulose-dressing): Transparent bacterial nanocellulose dressing for burns, donor sites and pediatric wounds.
- [Silicone Wound Contact Layer](https://velcura.net/silicone-contact-layer): Perforated soft-silicone contact layer for pain-free dressing changes.
- [Vaseline Gauze Dressing](https://velcura.net/vaseline-gauze): Non-adherent petrolatum gauze for minor burns, skin grafts and abrasions.
- [Wound Cleanser](https://velcura.net/wound-cleanser): pH-balanced irrigation solution for acute and chronic wounds.

## Film, IV and catheter dressings

- [Transparent IV Securement Dressing](https://velcura.net/transparent-film-iv): Sterile breathable film for peripheral and central catheters, up to 7-day wear.
- [Transparent Film I.V. Dressing with Notch](https://velcura.net/transparent-film-iv-notch): Frame-style film with a U-cut that seals around the catheter hub.
- [PICC Securement Dressing](https://velcura.net/picc-securement-dressing): Transparent film with a CHG gel pad for PICC, CVC and central lines.
- [Film Island Dressing](https://velcura.net/film-island-dressing): Waterproof transparent film with an absorbent pad for post-operative incisions.

## Surgical and everyday wound care

- [Surgical Incise Drape](https://velcura.net/incise-drape): Sterile transparent incision film.
- [Iodine Incise Drape](https://velcura.net/iodine-incise-drape): Incise drape with iodophor-impregnated adhesive for continuous antimicrobial activity.
- [Skin Closure Strip](https://velcura.net/skin-closure-strip): Reinforced sterile strips over a subcuticular suture or after early staple removal.
- [Wound Closure Strips](https://velcura.net/wound-closure-strips): Sterile strips for sutureless closure of small, low-tension lacerations.
- [Non-woven Adhesive Wound Dressing with Pad](https://velcura.net/non-woven-adhesive-with-pad): Soft island dressing for cuts, abrasions and post-operative wounds.
- [Non-woven Adhesive Wound Dressing Strip](https://velcura.net/non-woven-adhesive-strip): Cut-to-length dressing on a 10 m roll.
- [Non-woven Surgical Tape](https://velcura.net/non-woven-surgical-tape): Breathable hypoallergenic tape for dressing fixation.
- [Paper Tape](https://velcura.net/paper-tape): Microporous paper tape for fragile, neonatal and geriatric skin.
- [Medical Gauze Swab](https://velcura.net/medical-gauze-traditional): Absorbent cotton gauze, EO sterilized, multiple sizes.

- [Prophylactic Silicone Foam on the Sacrum — When to Apply](https://velcura.net/blog-prophylactic-sacral-silicone-foam-dressing): The 2026 guideline recommendation for multilayer soft silicone foam on sacrum and heels, risk triggers, wear, inspection and repositioning.
- [Washable Underpads · Why Reusable Beats Disposable](https://velcura.net/blog-washable-vs-disposable-underpads): Cost per bed per day with a calculator, five-layer TPU construction rated for 300+ washes, laundering rules and waste reduction.
- [Re-Epithelialization · When Is the Wound Truly Closed?](https://velcura.net/blog-re-epithelialization-wound-closure): What tissue does at 7, 14 and 28 days after closure, scar strength, chronic-wound recurrence and aftercare dressing choices.
- [Hypertrophic Scar Control After Surgical Closure](https://velcura.net/blog-hypertrophic-scar-prevention-after-surgery): Tension-free closure, when to start silicone gel sheets, wear time, paper-tape offloading, keloid distinction and when to escalate.
- [The Cost of Prevention vs the Cost of Cure](https://velcura.net/blog-pressure-injury-prevention-cost): Published pressure-injury cost estimates, why prevention is underfunded and a five-input business case for prophylactic dressings.
- [The Five-Step IAD Prevention Bundle](https://velcura.net/blog-iad-prevention-bundle): Cleanse, moisturize, protect, manage moisture and reposition — product choices, GLOBIAD categories and a shift checklist.
- [Velcura's New PICC Securement Dressing — Now Available](https://velcura.net/blog-picc-securement-dressing-chg-launch): Transparent film with an integrated CHG gel pad: up to 7 days antimicrobial activity, keyhole securement, specifications and evidence.
- [NPIAP / EPUAP Guideline Update — What Changed](https://velcura.net/blog-pressure-injury-guideline-2026-update): The 4th edition International Pressure Injury Guideline: GRADE methodology, prophylactic dressings, repositioning, support surfaces, nutrition, treatment and unchanged staging.
